This means that the frequency detected by the observer will be smaller than the frequency emitted by the pipe.

question.html:
A pipe is fixed to the top of a building. A standing sound wave is formed in the pipe. A person on a bike is moving away from the pipe at a speed of km h. 

a. Outline the difference between the frequency emitted by the pipe and the frequency detected by the person.

  [3]

b. There is a % change in the magnitude of the emitted frequency compared to the magnitude of the detected frequency. 

i. Show that the speed of the sound wave is 342 m s.

  [4]

ii. The distance between an adjacent node and antinode of the sound wave is 72 cm. Calculate the frequency of the sound wave.

  [2]

c. The speed of sound is related to the temperature of the medium it travels in by the equation where is the speed of sound and is the temperature of the medium in Kelvin. Find the temperature of the air at the location of the pipe. Give your answer in C.

  [2]
